title: Sorry for making a post regarding an AI plugin

posts.author: Ebon_Maker5
posts.body:
This is the post I'm talking about
I am sorry for the post I've made about an AI generated plugin yesterday- I should have read the rules first before posting as if I did I wouldn't have posted what I did- I had no intentions of "distributing" AI generated code, even if I did by making that post, and again regret making it
All I'm wanting to achieve with this Post is to just express that it was not a malicious intent or to spread AI garbage, I was only confused why what it "came up with" didn't work and wanted some coding advice on what would have went wrong....
The TLDR: I regret not reading the rules,(I have now) and I will be very mindful of what I post from now on, and also I'm sorry to anyone who thought I was trying to spread an AI plugin when that was not my intention :/
I'm open to discussion on this post
(This is
NOT
an AI made apology)

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: As far as I'm concerned, everyone learns from mistakes and what matters is that these mistakes make you learn, don't worry, I don't think anyone has any real reason to be angry on you or sth.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You're not required to make threads to apologize for accidental rules infractions.
As a side note, if you do a bit of search or asked a human who uses RPG Maker, what you're trying to accomplish is easily done with existing plugins, such as my Eval Tags or VisuStella Battle Core.

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
Nice to know, you can always ask your AI to give feedback to any code, even at my workplace we use AI as additional quality control. Or, pick a code section that you don't understand and ask the AI to explain it and repeat until you fully understand what's happening.
Of course, AI does make mistakes but so do human programmers as well

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
there are dozens of pots about AI use that explain our stance on AI as well.
you can search them if you want, but it comes down to how AIs work - because there is no true AI anywhere, human technology simply isn't that far and won't be for probably centuries.
